goal: Enable physical, human-verifiable paper backups and recovery for wallets using codex32 encoding
Allow descriptor wallets to retain seed material instead of requiring raw databases or long descriptors
reviewability: Waiting on author to answer open objections from Sjors and BenWestgate
agreement: Concept support because paper backups are a standard feature missing since legacy wallet removal (rkrux)
Unaddressed objection: bypasses descriptor backups and fragments key import logic away from addhdkey (Sjors)
Unaddressed objection: lacks wallet birth timestamps for rescanning and descriptor associations (BenWestgate)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it fills a key feature gap by enabling paper-based backup and recovery for descriptor wallets
Provides human-verifiable recovery without relying on raw database files or full descriptor strings
